title: Before ending an employment relationship
excerpt: Key legal recommendations to handle the termination of an employment contract in an informed way.

image.alt: Person signing a document on a desk

body:
Ending an employment contract has different consequences depending on how it happens. Knowing them helps you protect your rights, whether you are an employee or an employer.

## Ways to end a contract

- **Resignation** by the employee.
- **Mutual agreement** between the parties.
- **Dismissal for just cause**, on the grounds set out in the Labor Code.
- **Dismissal without just cause**, which requires paying compensation.

## What to review

- The final settlement: pending wages, severance and interest, service bonus and vacation.
- That social security contributions are up to date.
- Whether any special protection applies, such as maternity protection or reinforced stability for health reasons.
- The documents: termination letter, signed settlement and employment certificate.

Before signing an agreement or a settlement, it is worth reviewing it with a lawyer.
